name: Deping Hu (胡德平)
bio: Short bio (2–4 sentences). Research interests, key methods, and a fun fact if you like.

name: Haiyi Huang (黄海谊)
bio: He received his M.S. in chemistry in 2023 from South China Normal University (SCNU). His current interests in the Hu group are in the implementation of on-the-fly mapping dynamics and simulation of polaritonic system with deep learning with Equivariant Graph Neural Networks.

name: Linan Miao (缪立楠)
bio: Linan Miao received her B.Sc. in Chemistry (Education) from Liaoning Normal University in June 2024. Since September 2024, she has been pursuing her Ph.D. in chemistry at Beijing Normal University, where her current research focuses on ab initio dynamics studies of molecules inside optical microcavities.

name: Ying Zhai (翟颖)
bio: She received her B.Sc. in Chemistry from Xinyang Normal University in June 2026. Since September 2026, she has been pursuing her master's degree in chemistry at Beijing Normal University.

name: Wenhao Mo (莫文昊)
bio: He is a chemistry student at Beijing Normal University. He joined the Hu Group in 2024 and is working on the non-adiabatic dynamics simulations for polariton.

name: Tongtong Yu (余彤桐)
bio: She is a physics student at Beijing Normal University, and won the National Scholarship (2024-2025). She joined the Hu Group in 2025 and is working on the non-adiabatic dynamics simulations for polariton.
